declare void @throw_exception()

declare i32 @__gxx_personality_v0(...)

declare ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr)

declare void @__cxa_end_catch()

define void @test1() personality ptr @__gxx_personality_v0 {
entry:
  invoke void @throw_exception()
          to label %try.cont unwind label %lpad

lpad:                                             ; preds = %entry
  %0 = landingpad { ptr, i32 }
          catch ptr null
  %1 = extractvalue { ptr, i32 } %0, 0
  %2 = tail call ptr @__cxa_begin_catch(ptr %1)
  tail call void @__cxa_end_catch()
  br label %try.cont

try.cont:                                         ; preds = %lpad, %entry

define i32 @reduce_sum_4xi32(<4 x i32> %v) {
  %e0 = extractelement <4 x i32> %v, i32 0
  %e1 = extractelement <4 x i32> %v, i32 1
  %e2 = extractelement <4 x i32> %v, i32 2
  %e3 = extractelement <4 x i32> %v, i32 3
  %add0 = add i32 %e0, %e1
  %add1 = add i32 %add0, %e2
  %add2 = add i32 %add1, %e3
  ret i32 %add2
}

define <2 x i32> @test_pasubu_w(<2 x i32> %a, <2 x i32> %b) {
  %a_ext = zext <2 x i32> %a to <2 x i64>
  %b_ext = zext <2 x i32> %b to <2 x i64>
  %sub = sub <2 x i64> %a_ext, %b_ext
  %res = lshr <2 x i64> %sub, splat (i64 1)
  %res_trunc = trunc <2 x i64> %res to <2 x i32>
  ret <2 x i32> %res_trunc
}

  ret <2 x i32> %res
}

  %res = shl i256 %src, %bitOff

  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i1 %C, ptr poison, align 1
  store i1 %C1, ptr @G.1, align 1
  ret void
}

@G = external global i16

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @lshr_32bytes(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %byteOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %A5 = alloca i1, align 1
  store i1 false, ptr %A5, align 1
  %A = alloca i1, align 1
  store i1 true, ptr %A, align 1
  %LGV = load i16, ptr @G, align 2
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %byteOff = load i256, ptr %byteOff.ptr, align 1
  switch i16 %LGV, label %SW_D [
    i16 15978, label %SW_C
    i16 -29827, label %SW_C1
    i16 121, label %SW_C2
    i16 14029, label %SW_C3
    i16 25216, label %SW_C4
  ]

BB:                                               ; preds = %SW_C4, %SW_C3, %SW_C1, %SW_C, %SW_D
  %bitOff = shl i256 %byteOff, 3
  %res = lshr i256 %src, %bitOff
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  ret void

SW_D:                                             ; preds = %0
  br label %BB

SW_C:                                             ; preds = %0
  br label %BB

SW_C1:                                            ; preds = %0
  br label %BB

SW_C2:                                            ; preds = %0
  ret void

SW_C3:                                            ; preds = %SW_C3, %0
  %L = load i1, ptr %A, align 1
  br i1 %L, label %BB, label %SW_C3

SW_C4:                                            ; preds = %SW_C4, %0
  %L6 = load i1, ptr %A5, align 1
  br i1 %L6, label %BB, label %SW_C4
}

@G.1 = external global i1

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define void @shl_32bytes(ptr %src.ptr, ptr %byteOff.ptr, ptr %dst) #0 {
  %LGV = load i1, ptr @G.1, align 1
  %src = load i256, ptr %src.ptr, align 1
  %byteOff = load i256, ptr %byteOff.ptr, align 1
  %bitOff = shl i256 %byteOff, 3
  %res = shl i256 %src, %bitOff
  %C = icmp ult i1 false, %LGV
  store i256 %res, ptr %dst, align 1
  store i1 %C, ptr @G.1, align 1
  ret void
}

@G = external global i32
@G.1 = external global i16
@G.2 = external global i128

; Function Attrs: nounwind memory(none)
define { i128, i8 } @muloti_test(i128 %l, i128 %r) #0 {
start:
  %A = alloca i32, align 4
  %L1 = load i16, ptr %A, align 2
  store i32 poison, ptr %A, align 4
  %LGV = load i32, ptr @G, align 4
  %0 = tail call { i128, i1 } @llvm.umul.with.overflow.i128(i128 %l, i128 %r) #2
  %B3 = shl i128 %r, %l
  %B = udiv i32 -2147483648, %LGV
  %1 = extractvalue { i128, i1 } %0, 0
  %2 = extractvalue { i128, i1 } %0, 1
  %3 = zext i1 %2 to i8
  %4 = insertvalue { i128, i8 } poison, i128 %1, 0
  %B2 = sub i16 -1, %L1
  %5 = insertvalue { i128, i8 } %4, i8 %3, 1
  store i32 %B, ptr %A, align 4
  store i16 %B2, ptr @G.1, align 2
  store i128 %B3, ptr @G.2, align 4
  ret { i128, i8 } %5
}

  switch i1 %L, label %SW_D [
    i1 false, label %SW_C

  br label %BB

}

@G = external global i128

; Function Attrs: nounwind
define i128 @cmov128(i1 %a, i128 %b, i128 %c) #0 {
entry:
  %A = alloca i128, align 8
  store i128 -170141183460469231731687303715884105728, ptr %A, align 4
  %cond = select i1 %a, i128 %b, i128 %c
  %L = load i128, ptr %A, align 4
  switch i128 %L, label %SW_D [
    i128 9279628205291136958, label %SW_C
    i128 16825487932998630535, label %SW_C1
    i128 17991466054390011633, label %SW_C2
    i128 16388269529691961006, label %SW_C3
    i128 9457883115066350551, label %SW_C4
  ]

BB:                                               ; preds = %SW_C4, %SW_C3, %SW_C1
  ret i128 %cond

SW_D:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret i128 %cond

SW_C:                                             ; preds = %entry
  ret i128 %b

SW_C1:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB

SW_C2:                                            ; preds = %entry
  %LGV = load i128, ptr @G, align 4
  ret i128 %LGV

SW_C3:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB

SW_C4:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB
}

attributes #0 = { nounwind }
